pageSubtitle: We believe in complete transparency. Everything you need to know about shopping with Amayaa by Polka Dots.

sections.label: Section 01
sections.title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
sections.highlight: We currently ship across India. International shipping is available on request — please WhatsApp us before placing an order.
sections.content:
Processing Time

All orders are processed within 2–3 business days of payment confirmation. As each saree is a handloom piece, orders placed during festive seasons may take an additional 1–2 days.

Delivery Timelines

  • Metro cities (Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore, Kolkata, Chennai, Hyderabad) — 4–6 business days
  • Other cities & towns — 6–9 business days
  • Remote / rural areas — 10–14 business days
  • International — 15–21 business days (on request)

Shipping Partners

We ship via reputed courier partners (Blue Dart, Delhivery, or India Post depending on your pincode). A tracking number will be shared via WhatsApp or email once your order is dispatched.

Shipping Charges

  • Free shipping on orders above ₹5,000
  • ₹120 flat shipping charge for orders below ₹5,000
  • International shipping charges calculated at checkout (contact us for a quote)

Packaging

Every saree is carefully folded, wrapped in tissue paper, and packed in our signature box to protect the fabric during transit. We do not use plastic wrapping in line with our sustainability commitment.

sections.label: Section 02
sections.title: Cancellation & Refund Policy
sections.highlight: We take great care in curating authentic handloom pieces. Please read this policy carefully before placing your order.
sections.content:
Order Cancellation

  • Cancellations are accepted within 24 hours of placing the order, provided the item has not been dispatched
  • To cancel, WhatsApp us immediately with your order details
  • Orders that have already been dispatched cannot be cancelled
  • Custom or made-to-order sarees cannot be cancelled once production has begun

Returns & Exchanges

We accept returns or exchanges within 7 days of delivery under the following conditions:

  • Item received is significantly different from what was described or shown
  • Item has a manufacturing defect or damage caused during transit
  • Wrong item was delivered

Returns are not accepted for:

  • Change of mind after purchase
  • Minor colour variations due to screen settings (handloom colours may vary slightly from screen to actual)
  • Items that have been used, washed, or altered
  • Custom or personalised orders

Refund Process

Once we receive and inspect the returned item, refunds are processed within 7–10 business days to the original payment method. For COD orders, refunds are issued via bank transfer — please share your account details when raising a return request.

sections.label: Section 03
sections.title: Terms & Conditions
sections.content:
By accessing and placing an order through this website, you confirm that you are in agreement with and bound by the following terms and conditions.

Use of Website

  • This website is operated by Amayaa by Polka Dots, Kolkata, India
  • Content on this site is for general informational and commercial purposes only
  • You must be at least 18 years of age to place an order
  • You agree not to misuse the site or attempt to access it through unauthorised means

Product Information

We make every effort to display our products as accurately as possible. However, actual colours may vary due to your monitor settings and the natural characteristics of handloom fabric. Minor variations in weave, colour, or border are inherent to handcrafted textiles and are not considered defects.

Pricing & Payment

  • All prices are listed in Indian Rupees (₹) inclusive of applicable taxes
  • We accept payment via UPI, bank transfer, and WhatsApp Pay
  • Prices are subject to change without prior notice
  • Orders are confirmed only after full payment is received

Intellectual Property

All content on this website — including images, text, logos, and design — is the intellectual property of Amayaa by Polka Dots. Reproduction or commercial use without written permission is prohibited.

Limitation of Liability

Amayaa by Polka Dots shall not be liable for any indirect or consequential loss arising from the use of our products or website beyond the value of the product purchased.

Governing Law

These terms are governed by the laws of India. Any disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts in Kolkata, West Bengal.

sections.label: Section 04
sections.title: Privacy Policy
sections.highlight: We respect your privacy. We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties for marketing purposes.
sections.content:
Information We Collect

  • Name, phone number, email, and delivery address provided when placing an order
  • Payment details (processed securely — we do not store card or UPI information)
  • Device and browsing data collected via analytics (GoatCounter — privacy-friendly, no cookies)

How We Use Your Information

  • To process and fulfil your orders
  • To communicate order status and delivery updates via WhatsApp or email
  • To respond to your enquiries
  • To improve our website and product offerings

Data Storage & Security

Your personal information is stored securely and accessed only by authorised personnel for order fulfilment. We do not use tracking cookies or third-party advertising networks on this website.

WhatsApp Communication

When you contact us via WhatsApp, your number and messages are stored within WhatsApp's platform and subject to their privacy policy. We use WhatsApp solely for order-related communication.

Your Rights

You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us. We will respond within 7 business days.

sections.label: Section 05
sections.title: Disclaimer Policy
sections.content:
Product Authenticity

All sarees sold by Amayaa by Polka Dots are sourced directly from master weavers and established weaving clusters across India. We stand behind the authenticity of our products. However, as handloom textiles are made by hand, each piece is unique and may carry slight natural variations in weave density, motif placement, or colour — this is a hallmark of genuine handcrafted work, not a defect.

Colour Accuracy

We make every effort to photograph our sarees accurately under natural light. Despite this, colours displayed on screen depend heavily on your device's display settings. The actual product may appear slightly different. If colour accuracy is critical for you (e.g., for a wedding), please WhatsApp us and we will share additional photos or a video in natural light.

Website Content

The information on this website is provided in good faith and for general informational purposes. We do not warrant that the website will be uninterrupted, error-free, or free of viruses. We reserve the right to update or modify content without prior notice.

External Links

This website may contain links to external sites (e.g., WhatsApp, Instagram). We are not responsible for the content or privacy practices of those sites.

GI Tags & Heritage Claims

References to GI (Geographical Indication) tags, UNESCO recognition, and craft heritage on this website are based on publicly available information and are made in the spirit of celebrating India's textile legacy. For official GI certification of a specific product, please contact us directly.
